metas.name: Goosebumps
metas.description: A teenager teams up with the daughter of young-adult horror author R.L. Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Madison, Delaware.

metas.name: Black Bag
metas.description: When intelligence agent Kathryn Woodhouse is suspected of betraying the nation, her husband - also a legendary agent - faces the ultimate test of whether to be loyal to his marriage, or his country.

metas.name: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
metas.description: Cautious 40-year-old Yui Katakura gets a cancer diagnosis with one year to live, transforming her outlook. She meets Sena, a broke pink-haired host, pays 720,000 yen for his company, and their unusual bond evolves into unexpected ...

metas.name: Leviticus
metas.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

metas.name: Inglourious Basterds
metas.description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.

metas.name: Anora
metas.description: A young stripper from Brooklyn impulsively marries the son of Russian oligarchs, but her fairy tale is threatened when his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.

metas.name: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
metas.description: When a single mom and her two kids arrive in a small town, they begin to discover their connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather left behind.

metas.name: Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: Whiplash
metas.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

metas.name: The Nice Guys
metas.description: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate a missing girl and the mysterious death of a porn star.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Alien
metas.description: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: Friday the 13th
metas.description: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

metas.name: It
metas.description: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of Derry, their small Maine town.

metas.name: Wake Up Dead Man
metas.description: Detective Benoit Blanc teams up with an earnest young priest to investigate a perfectly impossible crime at a small-town church with a dark history.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: Addams Family Values
metas.description: The Addams Family try to rescue their beloved Uncle Fester from his gold-digging new love, a black widow named Debbie.

metas.name: Nocturnal Animals
metas.description: A wealthy art gallery owner is haunted by her ex-husband's novel, her memories of their relationship, and her regrets about her life.

metas.name: Barbarian
metas.description: A woman staying at an Airbnb discovers that the house she has rented is not what it seems.

metas.name: The Shining
metas.description: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter, where a sinister presence influences the father into violence. At the same time, his psychic son sees horrifying forebodings from both the past and the future.

metas.name: Richard Jewell
metas.description: Security guard Richard Jewell is an instant hero after foiling a bomb attack at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, but his life becomes a nightmare when the FBI leaks to the media that he is a suspect in the case.

metas.name: Pulp Fiction
metas.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

metas.name: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
metas.description: Manel is sheltering from a rabies-like disease which sweeps the planet, until he is forced to leave and meet unlikely but essential traveling companions.

metas.name: It Follows
metas.description: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.

metas.name: Locke
metas.description: Ivan Locke, a dedicated family man and successful construction manager, receives a phone call that sets in motion a series of events that threaten his carefully cultivated existence.

metas.name: Good Will Hunting
metas.description: A therapist counsels Will Hunting, a janitor with a genius IQ.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: American Graffiti
metas.description: A group of teenagers in California's central valley spend one final night after their 1962 high school graduation cruising the strip with their buddies before they pursue their varying goals.

metas.name: The Guns of Navarone
metas.description: A team of Allied saboteurs is assigned an impossible mission: infiltrate an impregnable Nazi-held Greek island and destroy the two enormous long-range field guns that prevent the rescue of 2,000 trapped British soldiers.

metas.name: Friday the 13th: Part 2
metas.description: Five years after the events of the first film, a summer camp next to the infamous Camp Crystal Lake is preparing to open, but the legend of Jason is weighing heavy on the proceedings.

metas.name: Schindler's List
metas.description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

metas.name: John Wick
metas.description: John Wick is a former hitman grieving the loss of his true love. When his home is broken into, robbed, and his dog killed, he is forced to return to action to exact revenge.

metas.name: The Crow
metas.description: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the mantle of the Crow, a supernatural...

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

metas.name: The Pelican Brief
metas.description: A law student uncovers a conspiracy, putting herself and others in danger.

metas.name: The Vanishing
metas.description: Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation. They stop at a busy service station and Saskia is abducted. After three years and no sign of Saskia, Rex begins receiving letters from the abductor.

metas.name: F1: The Movie
metas.description: A Formula One driver comes out of retirement to mentor and team up with a younger driver.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: In the small town of Woodsboro, California, a masked killer known as Ghostface begins murdering high school students, and a group of friends must use their knowledge of horror movies to unmask the killer.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: GoodFellas
metas.description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

metas.name: The Usual Suspects
metas.description: The sole survivor of a pier shoot-out tells the story of how a notorious criminal influenced the events that began with five criminals meeting in a seemingly random police lineup.

metas.name: Wuthering Heights
metas.description: A passionate and tumultuous love story set against the backdrop of the Yorkshire moors, exploring the intense and destructive relationship between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw.

metas.name: Coco
metas.description: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: One Night Only
metas.description: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

metas.name: Memento
metas.description: A former insurance investigator who now suffers from anterograde amnesia uses notes and tattoos to hunt down his wife's murderer.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

metas.name: Nuremberg
metas.description: A WWII psychiatrist evaluates Nazi leaders before the Nuremberg trials, growing increasingly obsessed with understanding evil as he forms a disturbing bond with Hermann Göring.

metas.name: Gladiator
metas.description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

metas.name: Hamnet
metas.description: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: In a world where mutants (evolved super-powered humans) exist and are discriminated against, two groups form for an inevitable clash: the supremacist Brotherhood, and the pacifist X-Men.

metas.name: Practical Magic
metas.description: Two witch sisters, raised by their eccentric aunts in a small town, face closed-minded prejudice and a curse which threatens to prevent them ever finding lasting love.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: An American expat tries to sell off his highly profitable marijuana empire in London, triggering plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

metas.name: Superman
metas.description: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way he soon finds himself in a world that views these as old-fashioned.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.

metas.name: The Thing
metas.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Two US marshals are sent to a mental institution on an inhospitable island in order to investigate the disappearance of a patient.

metas.name: Hellraiser
metas.description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

metas.name: Final Destination
metas.description: After getting a premonition about a plane crash on his school trip, Alex, a student, saves a few of his classmates. However, their situation gets complicated when death starts chasing them.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: Jill leaves voice messages to her deceased sister telling her about her chaotic life in San Francisco. Unwittingly, a mysterious Austin TX real estate agent begins to receive their confessions..

metas.name: How to Make a Killing
metas.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

metas.name: The Green Mile
metas.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

metas.name: The Witches
metas.description: A young boy stumbles onto a witch convention and must stop them, even after he has been turned into a mouse.

metas.name: Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: Forrest Gump
metas.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

metas.name: Gone Girl
metas.description: The husband of a missing woman becomes the main suspect in her disappearance.

metas.name: Evil Dead Rise
metas.description: A twisted tale of two estranged sisters whose reunion is cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

metas.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A bedridden boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: The Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends travel to a cabin in the woods, where they unknowingly release flesh-possessing demons.

metas.name: Tenet
metas.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: In Bruges
metas.description: After a job gone wrong, hitman Ray and his partner await orders from their ruthless boss in Bruges, Belgium, the last place in the world Ray wants to be.

metas.name: Pride & Prejudice
metas.description: When Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome Mr. Darcy, she believes he is the last man she could ever marry, but as their lives become intertwined, she finds herself captivated by the man she has sworn to hate forever.

metas.name: Haunted Mansion
metas.description: A single mom named Gabbie hires a tour guide, a psychic, a priest and a historian to help exorcise her newly bought mansion after discovering it is inhabited by ghosts.

metas.name: Irreversible
metas.description: Events over the course of one traumatic night in Paris unfold in reverse-chronological order.

metas.name: Love Actually
metas.description: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

metas.name: 28 Days Later
metas.description: Four weeks after a mysterious, incurable virus spreads throughout the United Kingdom, a handful of survivors try to find sanctuary.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description: A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
metas.description: A rebellious convict is sent to a psychiatric hospital for evaluation in 1963 Oregon, and encourages his docile companions to take more control of their lives and defy the tyrannical head nurse.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A couple travels to Northern Europe to visit a rural hometown's fabled Swedish mid-summer festival. What begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into an increasingly violent and bizarre competition at the hands of a pagan cult.

metas.name: 10 Things I Hate About You
metas.description: A high-school boy, Cameron, cannot date Bianca until her anti-social older sister, Kat, has a boyfriend. So, Cameron pays a mysterious boy, Patrick, to charm Kat.

metas.name: Elf
metas.description: A man raised by Santa's elves travels from the North Pole to New York City to meet his biological father, who doesn't know he exists and is in desperate need of some Christmas spirit.

metas.name: Death Becomes Her
metas.description: Two women vie for a man and the secret of eternal beauty.

metas.name: The Wailing
metas.description: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

metas.name: Hacksaw Ridge
metas.description: World War II American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, serving during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first man in American history to receive the Medal of Honor without firing a shot.

metas.name: Kingdom of Heaven
metas.description: Balian of Ibelin travels to Jerusalem during the Crusades of the 12th century, and there he finds himself as the defender of the city and its people.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: A weekend getaway with friends at a remote cabin turns into chaos after it's revealed that one of the guests is not what they seem.
